name: Micro-SaaS (Small Software Tool)

yield.notes: MRR model: $29-99/mo subscription. Requires solving a real problem with technical execution.

flags: High failure rate: 90% of SaaS products get <10 customers
Customer support requirements grow with user count

prerequisites: Programming skills or no-code tools (Bubble, Webflow, Glide)
startup_checklist: Identify a painful, specific problem in a niche you know well
Build MVP in 2-4 weeks using no-code tools or focused coding
Validate with 5 paying customers before adding features
Set up recurring billing via Stripe or Paddle
Automate onboarding and support with documentation and chatbot
failure_modes: Large player copies and bundles the feature for free
kill_criteria: Less than 5 paying customers after 6 months of active promotion
sources_note: Revenue data from Indie Hackers community reports.
